tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a single email via Resend. Supports HTML/text, cc/bcc, reply-to, attachments, tags, custom headers, scheduling, and templates. Uses RESEND_FROM as the default sender when `from` is omitted.

from.description: Sender, e.g. "Acme <hello@acme.com>". Falls back to RESEND_FROM. Domain must be verified.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address(es). Falls back to RESEND_REPLY_TO.

scheduledAt.description: Schedule for later: ISO-8601 or natural language like "in 1 hour" / "tomorrow at 9am"

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (defaults to the basename of localPath)

content.description: Base64-encoded file content (use this OR path OR localPath)

path.description: Public URL to the file (use this OR content OR localPath)

localPath.description: Path to a file inside RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR — read and base64-encoded automatically. Disabled unless RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR is set (use this OR content OR path)

templateId.description: Send using a saved template instead of html/text

templateData.description: Variables to interpolate into the template

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key to make retries safe (avoids duplicate sends)

tools.name: send_batch_emails
tools.description: Send up to 100 distinct emails in one call (one API request). Each entry is a full email object. Note: batch sends do NOT support attachments or scheduling per Resend limits.

from.description: Sender, e.g. "Acme <hello@acme.com>". Falls back to RESEND_FROM. Domain must be verified.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address(es). Falls back to RESEND_REPLY_TO.

templateId.description: Send using a saved template instead of html/text

templateData.description: Variables to interpolate into the template

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key for the whole batch

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Retrieve a single sent email by ID, including its current delivery status.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List sent emails (paginated). Useful to find recent sends and their IDs.

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: update_email
tools.description: Update a scheduled email — currently only the scheduled send time can be changed.

scheduledAt.description: New schedule: ISO-8601 or natural language like "in 2 hours"

tools.name: cancel_email
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled email that has not been sent yet.

tools.name: preview_email
tools.description: Dry-run an email WITHOUT sending it. Resolves the final `from` (incl. RESEND_FROM default), validates the payload, reads/sizes any local attachments, and returns a summary plus warnings. Use to verify a message before calling send_email.

from.description: Sender, e.g. "Acme <hello@acme.com>". Falls back to RESEND_FROM. Domain must be verified.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address(es). Falls back to RESEND_REPLY_TO.

scheduledAt.description: Schedule for later: ISO-8601 or natural language like "in 1 hour" / "tomorrow at 9am"

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (defaults to the basename of localPath)

content.description: Base64-encoded file content (use this OR path OR localPath)

path.description: Public URL to the file (use this OR content OR localPath)

localPath.description: Path to a file inside RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR — read and base64-encoded automatically. Disabled unless RESEND_ATTACHMENTS_DIR is set (use this OR content OR path)

templateId.description: Send using a saved template instead of html/text

templateData.description: Variables to interpolate into the template

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key to make retries safe (avoids duplicate sends)

tools.name: list_email_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of a sent email.

tools.name: get_email_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve a single attachment of a sent email by attachment ID (returns metadata / download info).

tools.name: list_received_emails
tools.description: List inbound (received) emails. Requires email receiving to be configured on your Resend account.

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: get_received_email
tools.description: Retrieve a single received email by ID, including parsed headers and body.

tools.name: list_received_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of a received email.

tools.name: get_received_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve a single attachment of a received email by attachment ID.

tools.name: create_domain
tools.description: Add a sending domain to Resend. Returns the DNS records (SPF, DKIM, optional DMARC) you must add to your DNS provider before verifying.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Retrieve a domain by ID, including verification status and the full list of DNS records with their current state.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all domains on the account with their verification status.

tools.name: update_domain
tools.description: Update a domain's settings: open/click tracking and TLS enforcement.

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Permanently delete a domain from Resend.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Trigger verification for a domain after adding its DNS records. Re-checks SPF/DKIM. Use diagnose_domain for a human-readable report of what is still missing.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new Resend API key. The full key value is returned ONLY once — store it securely. Optionally scope it to sending-only and to a single domain.

name.description: A label for the key, e.g. 'production'

domain_id.description: Restrict a sending_access key to a single domain ID

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys (metadata only — secret values are never returned).

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Permanently revoke an API key by ID.

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.description: Create a broadcast (newsletter / campaign) targeted at an audience or segment. Created as a draft — use send_broadcast to deliver or schedule it.

audience_id.description: Target audience ID (audience or segment must be provided)

html.description: HTML body (use {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}} for the unsubscribe link)

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.description: Retrieve a broadcast by ID, including its status (draft/scheduled/sent) and stats.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description: List all broadcasts (paginated).

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: update_broadcast
tools.description: Update a draft broadcast's content or settings (from, subject, html, text, etc.).

tools.name: send_broadcast
tools.description: Send a broadcast now, or schedule it for later. Omit scheduledAt to send immediately.

scheduledAt.description: ISO-8601 or natural language like "tomorrow at 9am". Omit to send now.

tools.name: delete_broadcast
tools.description: Delete a broadcast (only drafts and scheduled broadcasts can be deleted).

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Provide email plus optional name and custom properties. `unsubscribed` controls subscription state.

properties.description: Custom property values keyed by property name

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieve a contact by ID or by email address.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (paginated).

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact's name, subscription state, or custom properties.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact by ID or email address.

tools.name: get_contact_topics
tools.description: List the topic subscriptions of a contact.

tools.name: update_contact_topics
tools.description: Update a contact's topic subscriptions (opt-in / opt-out of specific topics).

tools.name: list_contact_segments
tools.description: List the segments a contact belongs to.

tools.name: add_contact_to_segment
tools.description: Add a contact to a segment.

tools.name: remove_contact_from_segment
tools.description: Remove a contact from a segment.

tools.name: create_contact_property
tools.description: Create a custom contact property (a field you can store on every contact, e.g. 'plan' or 'signup_date').

tools.name: get_contact_property
tools.description: Retrieve a contact property by ID.

tools.name: list_contact_properties
tools.description: List all custom contact properties defined on the account.

tools.name: update_contact_property
tools.description: Rename a contact property.

tools.name: delete_contact_property
tools.description: Delete a contact property by ID.

tools.name: create_segment
tools.description: Create a segment — a saved, optionally rule-based grouping of contacts you can target with broadcasts.

filter.description: Optional filter rules object defining segment membership

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: Retrieve a segment by ID.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List all segments.

tools.name: delete_segment
tools.description: Delete a segment by ID.

tools.name: list_segment_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to a segment (paginated).

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a reusable email template. Use {{variable}} placeholders in html/text and pass values via send_email's templateData.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Retrieve a template by ID.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all templates (paginated).

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a template's name, subject, or body. Creates a new draft version.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a template by ID.

tools.name: publish_template
tools.description: Publish a template's draft so it becomes the live version used by sends.

tools.name: duplicate_template
tools.description: Duplicate an existing template into a new one.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a topic — a subscription category (e.g. 'Product updates', 'Promotions') contacts can opt in/out of independently.

name.description: Topic name shown in subscription preferences

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Retrieve a topic by ID.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all topics.

tools.name: update_topic
tools.description: Update a topic's name or description.

tools.name: delete_topic
tools.description: Delete a topic by ID.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook endpoint that receives Resend events. Returns a signing secret used to verify payloads.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that will receive event POSTs

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Retrieve a webhook by ID (including its subscribed events and status).

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List all configured webhooks.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook's endpoint URL, subscribed events, or enabled status.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by ID.

tools.name: list_logs
tools.description: List API request logs — every request made to your Resend account with status code, endpoint and timing. The backbone for debugging. For smart filtering use search_logs.

after.description: Pagination cursor: return items after this ID

before.description: Pagination cursor: return items before this ID

tools.name: get_log
tools.description: Retrieve a single API request log entry by ID, with full request/response detail.

tools.name: diagnose_domain
tools.description: Deep DNS/verification diagnosis for a sending domain. Fetches the domain, inspects every required DNS record (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, Return-Path), reports what is verified vs. pending/missing, and gives concrete fix steps. Use this whenever sending fails with 'domain not verified' or before going live.

tools.name: analyze_deliverability
tools.description: Aggregate the MOST RECENT sent emails (up to 100 — a single page, not the full history) into deliverability metrics: delivered / bounced / complained / suppressed / opened / clicked counts and rates, plus a health verdict and recommendations. Use to answer 'how is my email health?' or to investigate a recent drop in delivery.

sample.description: How many recent emails to analyze (default 100)

tools.name: inspect_email
tools.description: Full lifecycle view of one email: fetches it and renders a readable timeline of its events (sent → delivered → opened → clicked, or bounced/complained), highlighting the final state and any problem. Use to answer 'what happened to this email?'.

tools.name: explain_bounce
tools.description: Diagnose why an email bounced. Fetches the email, classifies the bounce as hard / soft / block / suppressed, explains it in plain language, and recommends the correct action (remove address, retry later, fix content, etc.).

tools.name: audit_account
tools.description: One-shot health check of the whole Resend account: lists domains (and whether they're verified), API keys, and recent deliverability (most recent 100 emails), then returns a prioritized list of problems and recommendations. Great first call when 'emails aren't working'.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Smart search over API request logs: fetch recent logs and filter by HTTP status, status class (e.g. only errors), endpoint path substring, and/or recipient. Returns matching entries plus a breakdown of error types. Use to find why requests are failing.

sample.description: How many recent logs to scan (default 100)

status.description: Exact HTTP status to match, e.g. 422

path_contains.description: Substring of the endpoint path, e.g. "/emails"

recipient_contains.description: Substring to match against recipient/email fields

tools.name: test_send
tools.description: Validate your sending setup by sending to Resend's sandbox addresses, which deterministically simulate outcomes WITHOUT hurting your reputation. Choose 'delivered', 'bounced', or 'complained'. Returns the resulting email ID so you can inspect_email it.

tools.name: resend_raw
tools.description: Advanced escape hatch — make a raw authenticated request to ANY Resend API endpoint not covered by a dedicated tool. Prefer specific tools when one exists. Mutating methods (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) are blocked in readonly mode.

path.description: Endpoint path starting with "/", e.g. "/emails" or "/domains/{id}"
